Warnings array is empty for complex but valid HTML

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<article><h1>Article</h1><p>Paragraph with <strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em>.</p><table><tr><th>Col</th></tr><tr><td>Val</td></tr></table><ul><li>Item 1</li><li>Item 2</li></ul></article>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
debugPrint(result.warnings)
```
